# realtor.com

> > realtor.com is a comprehensive real estate platform connecting buyers, sellers, and agents with homes for sale, neighborhood data, school information, and professional resources.

realtor.com provides integrated real estate search, local community insights including school district profiles and ratings, and professional tools for real estate agents. The platform aggregates property listings, neighborhood guides, and educational institution data to help users make informed decisions about buying, selling, and relocating.
